usage_note: Only the head noun 'rinktinė' declines; 'Estijos vyrų futbolo' stays in the genitive. In running sports copy the short form is the country name 'Estija' (feminine, declined normally: Estijos, Estijai, Estiją, su Estija, Estijoje). This is common in scorelines such as 'Lietuva – Estija 1:0'. 'Estijos rinktinė' (Estijos rinktinės, Estijos rinktinei…) is also widely used as a mid-length form. Include 'vyrų' only when it is needed to distinguish the team from the women's or youth teams.
